title: Care Management Contact Standards — Training Note on What Counts
content:
Training note for care teams and member services representatives on the Care Management contact standards.

## The standard

The care team makes at least the tier's minimum number of successful contacts in each calendar month, using the tier's counted contact modes, and at least the tier's minimum number of in-person or home visits per calendar quarter. Unsuccessful attempts never count as contacts, and a month in which the episode was on hold for the whole month has no minimum.

The monthly count is the number of successful care team contacts recorded on the episode within the calendar month whose contact mode is one of the tier's counted modes.

## Questions answered

**Does a call that did not reach the member count?** No. Only successful contacts count; an unsuccessful attempt never counts as a contact, whatever its mode.

**Over what period is each minimum measured?** The contact minimum over each calendar month, and the visit minimum over each calendar quarter.

**Does every successful contact count toward the month?** Only a contact whose mode is one of the tier's counted modes.

**What if the episode was on hold for the entire month?** That month has no minimum.

**Which contacts count toward the quarterly visit minimum?** In-person visits and home visits.

## Tally (hypothetical month)

Hypothetical inputs: a tier whose monthly minimum is 2, whose counted modes are phone, video, in person and home visit, and whose quarterly visit minimum is 1; the episode is active all month.

| Date | Mode | Outcome | Counts toward the month | Counts toward the quarter's visits |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3rd | Phone | Not reached | No | No |
| 8th | Text | Reached | No, mode not counted in this tier | No |
| 15th | Video | Reached | Yes | No |
| 27th | Home visit | Reached | Yes | Yes |

Result: 2 counted contacts, meeting the monthly minimum of 2, and 1 home visit toward the quarter.

The same member whose episode was on hold from the 1st to the last day of the following month has no minimum for that month.
